Manship Church

Preserved Primary Document • manship.htm

According to Weslager's Delaware's Forgotten Folk", an earlier church, built around 1830, occupied the site before being replaced by this newer church built around 1875. Unfortunately, many people buried at Manship have no markers or else original the markers have been lost. I have not yet had access to the original church records so the below list is only a partial listing of names and dates. I have also not yet had a chance to go back and double check these notes for accuracy against the actual markers. I am planning to do that shortly. For a more detailed listing visit the Mitsawokett site . Manship Church
Preserved Primary Document • manship.htm

1830

1875
.
